text:
Rosa (People Ops): FYI we've updated the parental leave policy section in the handbook. This is primarily clarifications around eligibility windows and the payout timeline. All staff need to acknowledge by Jun 10. Link: https://intra.redwood.ai/handbook/parental-leave

Evan (HR Business Partner): Quick note: the change affects hires retroactively only if they were on active leave when the policy updated. See the doc for details.

Priya (Recruiter): For hiring ops : do we need updated offer language for new hires starting after the effective date?

Rosa (People Ops): Yes. Recruiting + Legal will have an updated offer blurb to copy. Priya I'll DM the template.

Omar (Eng): Will this change payroll timing? I run monthly contractor reconciliations and need the exact dates.

Evan (HR Business Partner): Payroll changes are only for employees on paid parental leave; contractors unaffected. Payroll will post a short memo next week with exact cutoff dates.

Nate (Contractor): As a contractor with a long-term retainer, who do I talk to if my client-side benefits expect something different?

Priya (Recruiter): @Nate I'll loop in vendor-ops. We may need a contract amendment path; we'll share guidance.

Rosa (People Ops): Admin mechanics: 1) Acknowledge policy in People Ops portal (takes <2min). 2) Managers: confirm team acknowledgements by Jun 12. 3) We'll export a CSV for managers and people-ops leads.

Omar (Eng): Can we get a short Q&A doc or a one-slide summary for team syncs?

Rosa (People Ops): Yes 642 I'll post a one-pager + slide later today. Also a short script for managers to read.

Evan (HR Business Partner): Compliance flag: If someone disputes retroactive applicability, escalate to HR with their case file ID. We'll route to Legal.

ComplianceBot: Reminder set: parental-acknowledgement-due on 1769984523

Priya (Recruiter): Recruiting checklist update: add "policy acknowledgement due date" to offer tracker for roles with parental leave expectations. Will push change by EOD.

Nate (Contractor): Thanks 44d For contractor amendment path please advise timeline.

Rosa (People Ops): We'll aim for guidance on contractor amendments by next Tue. If anyone needs an exception, managers submit an HR ticket with reason and timeline.

Omar (Eng): Sounds good. I'll schedule a 10-min slot in our next all-hands to remind folks.

Rosa (People Ops): Appreciate it. Final ask: managers, reply in-thread with a quick "ack confirm" once you've scheduled team reminders.

Priya (Recruiter): ack confirm

Omar (Eng): ack confirm

Evan (HR Business Partner): ack confirm
